    Methods in com.egradx.auth.config with parameters of type EgradxAuthenticationEntryPoint

    org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain
    EgradxAuthAutoConfiguration.egradxAuthDefaultSecurityFilterChain(org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity http, EgradxAuthenticationFilter egradxAuthenticationFilter, EgradxAuthenticationEntryPoint egradxAuthenticationEntryPoint, EgradxAccessDeniedHandler egradxAccessDeniedHandler)
    Depending on egradx-web-security (for token verification) transitively pulls in spring-boot-starter-security's OAuth2-resource-server bits, which makes Spring Boot's own "authenticate every request" default security auto-configuration active on the classpath — that would 401/403 every request in the whole host app, including egradx-auth's own /register and /login, before any of our code even runs.
